propositions: Hardcoded Jira mappings in value_maps.py, config.py, and inbound_fields.py must be replaced by a provider-neutral config-driven foundation before any axis can be externalized.
The mapping config section must be recognized as reserved (like llm and snapshot), parsed raw without triggering unknown-key warnings, and read via read_reserved_section.

Axis maps must deep-merge per key (built-in ← default ← project) so overlay entries override only named keys and unnamed keys inherit, while vocabulary declarations replace wholesale per layer (most-specific wins, not unioned).

Config validation must fail closed offline by ensuring every axis-map value appears in its declared vocabulary set and rejecting malformed blocks or capability-absent axis references, raising MappingConfigError.
A Capability descriptor dataclass must declare which mapping axes a target's vocabulary supports (has_types, has_transitions, has_hierarchy, has_link_types, has_priorities) to gate axis validation.
The core module must remain provider-neutral, importing no Jira adapter and carrying no vendor-specific value literal, with concrete backends injecting built-in defaults via the vendor-adapter seam.
